newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's July CPI seen at 1.6 pct yr/yr--analysts.
newsitem.headline: Italy's July CPI seen at 1.6 pct yr/yr--analysts.

text.p: Italy's July consumer price index (CPI) is forecast at 1.6 percent year-on-year and 0.0 percent month-on-month according to analysts' forecasts on Tuesday after all eleven cities had reported preliminary CPI July.
This compares with a year-on-year rate of 1.4 percent and a month-on-month rate of 0.0 percent in June.
Analysts had forecast July CPI inflation to stand at 1.6 percent year-on-year and 0.0 percent month-on-month.
Five Italian cities released their data on Monday, and a further six reported their figures Tuesday. The eleven cities have a total weighing of 75.66 percent on the national index.
Statistics institute ISTAT will announce the final July CPI figures on August 5.
